commit_message: Renderer: advance material contract to schema v3
pr_title: Renderer: add PBR material texture contract
pr_body: Phase 2B renderer foundation. This first staged commit advances MaterialAsset to schema v3 and adds generic metallic/roughness, occlusion, normal scale, and occlusion strength fields with current-format-only validation. Follow-up dispatcher commits wire the format-neutral IR/importers, runtime shader inputs, documentation, and generated tangent basis.
